description:
About Us: 

 Atto Trading, a dynamic quantitative trading firm founded in 2010 and leading in global high-frequency strategies, is looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to join our team.

 We are expanding an international, diverse team, with experts in trading, statistics, engineering, and technology. Our disciplined approach combined with rapid market feedback allows us to quickly turn ideas into profit. Our environment of learning and collaboration allows us to solve some of the world’s hardest problems, together. As a small firm, we remain nimble and hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity, ingenuity, and effort.

 Position Highlights: 

 We are looking for an Infrastructure  Engineer who has experience designing, building, and deploying scalable infrastructure for research and production trading. As we are rapidly growing, this role will have a major impact on the future of our software systems. Less manual, more automation!

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Design, build, and support low-latency trading infrastructure

 Troubleshoot complex issues across the OS, storage, networking, and HPC clusters, working closely with other teams

 Automate server provisioning and configuration management

 Maintain and scale data storage systems

 Identify manual or repetitive workflows and design automation to improve reliability and user experience

 Deploy and support containerized applications

 Administer observability and source control platforms

 Evaluate emerging hardware and software relevant to trading, HPC, and storage, and propose improvements

 Coordinate with remote data center technicians on hardware installs and repairs

 Maintain clear documentation and a structured knowledge base

 
 Requirements: 

 
 1+  years of experience in Linux systems engineering or administration

 Solid understanding of Linux internals

 Strong understanding of computer system architecture

 Good grasp of networking fundamentals

 Strong scripting skills in Python and/or Bash

 Experience with configuration management and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Ansible

 Experience with containers (Docker, Podman; Kubernetes is a plus)

 AI & Productivity Tools: Demonstrated ability to effectively leverage modern AI tools (e.g., generative AI, code assistants, research and productivity tools) to improve quality, speed, decision-making, and workflow efficiency while maintaining strong judgment, accuracy, and ownership of outcomes

 
 Nice to have: 

 
 Hands-on experience with observability tools

 Experience with low latency L1/1.5 network devices

 Experience with Solarflare or Mellanox network cards

 Experience with Kubernetes (bare-metal and cloud environments)

 Experience with Big-Data Processing and Analysis Pipelines such as Jenkins or similar

 Experience Working in a Trading Firm is a significant plus

 Genuine Interest in Finance and Trading

 
 Additional expectations: 

 
 Passion for Continuous Learning

 Strong Sense of Responsibility

 Ability to Make Independent and Timely Decisions

 Skill in Finding Innovative Solutions

 Service-Oriented Mindset

 
 Benefits: 

 
 Competitive compensation package

 Performance-based bonus opportunities

 401k plan

 Mental health support, including access to therapy

 Paid time off (4 weeks)

 Relocation support (where applicable)

 International team meet-ups

 Learning and development support, including courses and certifications

 Access to professional tools, software, and resources

 Fully equipped workstations with high-quality hardware

 Modern office with paid lunches

 
 Annual base salary range of $120,000 to $180,000. Pay (base and bonus) may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

 Our motivation: 

 We are a company committed to staying at the forefront of technology. Our team is passionate about continual learning and improvement. With no external investors or customers, we are the primary users of the products we create, giving you the opportunity to make a real impact on our company's growth.

 Ready to advance your career? Join our innovative team and help shape the future of trading on a global scale. Apply now and let's create the future together!
